# Handoff

> > Handoff provides detailed construction cost data and contractor pricing estimates for residential home improvement projects across the United States.

The platform offers comprehensive cost breakdowns for installation, remodeling, and maintenance tasks, helping contractors and homeowners estimate project budgets with region-specific pricing per square foot, linear foot, or unit. Content includes both cost reference data and educational guides for home improvement projects.

## Key Topics

- construction costs
- contractor pricing
- cost estimation
- residential construction
- installation costs
- home improvement
- energy efficiency
- United States pricing
- fiberglass insulation
- cellulose insulation
- spray foam
- roofing projects
- bathroom remodeling
- contractor estimates

## Insulation & Energy Efficiency

- [Cost to install attic insulation in the US](https://www.handoff.ai/construction-costs/install-attic-insulation): Attic insulation costs: $1.35-$4.06/SF for fiberglass, cellulose, foam
- [Cost to install floor insulation in the US](https://www.handoff.ai/construction-costs/install-floor-insulation): Floor insulation costs: $1.78-$4.26/SF for fiberglass, foam, spray
- [Cleaning and Maintaining HVAC Filters: A Step-by-Step Guide](https://www.handoff.ai/blog/cleaning-and-maintaining-hvac-filters-a-step-by-step-guide): Step-by-step HVAC filter maintenance guide by Dmitry Alexin
- [Cost to install baseboard heater in the US](https://www.handoff.ai/construction-costs/install-baseboard-heater): Baseboard heater installation: $262-$562/EA for electric/hydronic units
